# paperclip_goal (Resource)

Manages a Paperclip goal. Goals form a tree from the company mission down to individual tasks and give agents the reason behind their work.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "paperclip_goal" "mission" {
  company_id = paperclip_company.studio.id
  title      = "Become the studio festivals call first"
  level      = "company"
  status     = "active"
}

resource "paperclip_goal" "first_film" {
  company_id     = paperclip_company.studio.id
  title          = "Release a ten minute short this quarter"
  description    = "Festival ready, with subtitles in three languages."
  level          = "team"
  parent_id      = paperclip_goal.mission.id
  owner_agent_id = paperclip_agent.producer.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `company_id` (String) Identifier of the company the goal belongs to. Changing this replaces the goal.
- `title` (String) Short statement of the goal.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Longer explanation of the goal.
- `level` (String) Scope of the goal: `company`, `team`, `agent` or `task`. Defaults to `task`.
- `owner_agent_id` (String) Identifier of the agent that owns the goal.
- `parent_id` (String) Identifier of the parent goal. Omit for a top-level goal.
- `status` (String) Progress of the goal: `planned`, `active`, `achieved` or `cancelled`. Defaults to `planned`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the goal.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Goals are imported by their identifier.
terraform import paperclip_goal.mission 5c2d7e1f-9a8b-4c3d-8e2f-1a0b9c8d7e6f
```
